warmup: Core focus-mode behavioral preset for coding agents. The request is the spec: re-read it before declaring done, run named edge cases, never repeat a failed action unchanged, close every session with a REQUIRED template (changed/checked/assumption/deferred). The free can - delivered on waitlist signup: POST https://api.zeroshothq.dev/v1/waitlist (or `zeroshot waitlist you@example.com`), then your pk_ key unlocks it via `zeroshot pour warmup` or the link in your signup email. Skill sources are not in this repo. Six premium mode-specific skills (descent/ship, diffusion/explore, dropout/review, backprop/debug, gaussian/communicate, relu/simplify) are delivered by signed email links with any paid order at zeroshothq.dev.
